$comment: A runtime adapter descriptor. Binding support is evaluated independently per artifact kind (ARCH-50): support for one capability never implies support for another. Observation declares may-execute-model because on this runtime the only way to observe effective state is a billable model turn (DOC-2, 'Discovery Suitability'), and a caller must not treat that like free read-only discovery. The skill binding is unverified rather than unsupported: Dotbabel has no evidence either way, and unverified is never coerced to supported (ARCH-44).
